name: White-sidewall road tire (158H2401)

origin.basis: Giant Group was founded in 1972 in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: The official store listing does not state the factory.

positioning: Giant's China-market 120 TPI folding road tire with white sidewalls.
weight_basis: No weight is given in the listing.

availability.note: Sold by Giant's official Tmall store in mainland China; this China-market model was not checked in other regions.

price_observations.market: Giant official Tmall store (捷安特官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 98.

caveats: Specifications beyond TPI are not published in the listing.
No independent lab test or owner report found.
